# DESIGN.md

<!-- Generated by `npm run apply-design` from design/system.yaml: change the record, not this file. -->

**Storefront.** A clean, confident sales page for each company, built only from what it states. Warm white, deep evergreen and real star gold, one serif voice for promises, and one obvious next step on every screen.

The tokens are compiled into `styles/theme.css`.

## Identity

```text
Subject:            A ready-made one-page site for one local business: its offers, guarantees, reviews, people and work
Audience:           Someone about to hire, who wants the best deal from a company they can trust, and fast
One job:            Show why to pick this company, then make asking for a quote the obvious next step
Direction:          Storefront: a focused, benefit-led sales page, where every claim is true and traceable
Source:             The clearest local-service landing pages, without their clutter
Signature:          A plain promise with checkmarks and a real photo, then real reviews moving past
Rejection:          Invented claims, a score of our own, sponsored rows, stock photos and walls of terms
Photography:        Each company's own pictures, large and early; never stock
```

## Visual Theme & Atmosphere

A company page is one argument from top to bottom: a plain promise and a real photo, proof from customers, what is on offer, what is guaranteed, who does the work, and one obvious next step. Every claim comes from a record, and its sources are listed together at the foot.

`canvas` is the page, `panel` a tinted band, `night` the one dark band for reviews and the request, and the footer. `ink` is text, `ink-2` secondary, `ink-3` captions. `accent` is every action and check, `accent-soft` behind a check. `star` is only for a platform's real stars. `mark` on `mark-soft` is only for what is on offer now.

## Typography Rules

| Class | Family | Size | Line height | Tracking | Weight |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `text-display` | Newsreader | clamp(2.375rem, 5.2vw, 4rem) | 1.04 | -0.022em | 500 |
| `text-section` | Newsreader | clamp(1.75rem, 3.2vw, 2.625rem) | 1.1 | -0.018em | 500 |
| `text-title` | Figtree | 1.125rem | 1.3 | -0.008em | 650 |
| `text-lede` | Figtree | clamp(1.0625rem, 1.3vw, 1.25rem) | 1.45 |  | 400 |
| `text-copy` | Figtree | 1rem | 1.55 |  | 400 |
| `text-label` | Figtree | 0.8125rem | 1.4 |  | 500 |

`text-display` is the page's promise, `text-section` every h2, `text-title` a card's name, `text-lede` the line under a heading, `text-copy` text, `text-label` a caption or a source.

## Component Stylings

Check is the signature, beside anything a company states. Stars show only a platform's real number. OfferCard, GuaranteeCard, CompanyCard and ReviewCard are the page's parts, each one glance long, with "Terms apply" linking out where terms exist. They are in src/components.tsx.

## Layout Principles

Every band shares one frame, max-w-wide with px-5 sm:px-8. Section headings sit centred above their content, and long text narrows to max-w-content. Sections alternate canvas and panel so each reads as one idea, and the footer stays at the foot of a short page.

## Depth & Elevation

Cards and the hero photo lift softly off the page. A hairline edges a form control.

## Motion

Reviews drift slowly, pause on hover and stand still for anyone who asks for less motion. Hover and focus take 150ms with `ease-soft`. Nothing else moves.

## Responsive Behavior

A phone gets one column and a bar at the bottom with the two actions.

## Do's and Don'ts

Do:

- Lead with what the customer gets, in as few words as possible.
  These pages are read in a hurry, by someone deciding who to call.
- Name what a thing is in plain words: a label, not a slogan.
  'Compared on what they actually state' sounds generated; 'Find HVAC companies in Round Rock' says what the page does.
- Use the tokens; add one to this record when one is missing.
  A one-off value in markup is a second design system that nobody maintains.

Don't:

- Don't show stars, a 'free' or a guarantee the record can't back.
  One invented claim costs the whole site its trust.
- Don't merge ratings or make a score.
  A number of ours would claim a judgment we never made.
- Don't show a blank as no, or as a row saying not stated.
  A section with nothing to say is left out.

## Known Gaps

No company's own colours: every page is the site's.

## Changing the design

Edit `design/system.yaml` and run `npm run apply-design`.
A new brand colour or font goes into the record's tokens by role, never into markup. How a record is
written, and how it grows from the first homepage, is the `design` skill.
